name: Level Biotechnology Inc.
summary: Level Biotechnology Inc., founded in 1989 and based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, operates in the commercialization and distribution of scientific products and services. The company supplies specialized reagents and consumables for cell culture, immunology, and molecular biology, alongside advanced biomedical instrumentation, throughout Taiwan. Beyond product distribution, Level Biotechnology offers a comprehensive suite of research and testing services. These include expert assessments in mammalian and genetic toxicology, pharmacological studies, biocompatibility testing, and the production of model animals. The firm's preclinical research capabilities serve a diverse range of clients in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical device, animal health, and agrichemical industries.
